title: ‘Rumi in a Ramyeon Cup’ Is the Must-Have 3D Puzzle Inspired by HUNTR/X’s Hungry Lead Singer
summary: The building kit comes on the heels of Hungry Rumi memes, depicting the KPop Demon Hunters character snacking on everything from kimbap to candy.
contentText:

We all know Elf on a Shelf , or even Snoop on a Stoop , but could this year’s hottest toy be Rumi in a Ramyeon cup?

Meet the latest merch release from Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters : this 138-piece 3D puzzle that forms a standing figurine of Rumi eating her branded ramyeon (Korean instant noodles).

SELLING FAST

KPop Demon Hunters Rumi in Ramyeon Cup 3D Puzzle

$19.99 $21.99 9% off

Buy Now On WALMART

Buy Now On AMAZON

The 2-in-1 building kit also lets you build a larger ramyeon cup that Rumi can sit in, with her name displayed on the back of the lid.

Unlike LEGO sets , which use hard plastic blocks, this 3D puzzle uses pre-cut foam puzzle pieces, which all fit and snap together with no glue or tools needed for assembly. The finished product measures approximately 7.8 x 15 inches when Rumi is in the ramyeon cup.

The puzzle set comes on the heels of hundreds of “ Hungry Rumi ” memes online, depicting the HUNTR/X lead singer snacking on everything from kimbap to candy. And if working on this building kit makes you hungry for actual ramen: you can pick up official KPop Demon Hunters instant noodle cups here .

This is an officially licensed release from Netflix and 4D Build , the puzzle company known for their collectible 3D model kits.

MOVABLE PIECES

KPop Demon Hunters Derpy Tiger & Sussie Bird 3D Puzzle

$21.99

Buy Now AT WALMART

4D Build also has this Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird 3D puzzle kit, with 168 pieces.

This 3D puzzle brings the blue supernatural tiger to life on a pedestal, with his sidekick (and Jinu’s pet bird) Sussie, perched on his head. This design lets you move or remove different parts, to change up the design. For example, Derpy’s tongue can be removed and the flowerpot can sit in different ways on the stand. The finished puzzle measures 9.8 x 9.1 inches in size.

CHIBI COLLECTIBLE

Kpop Demon Hunters HUNTR/X Chibi Character 3D Puzzle Model Kit

$24.64

Amazon also has this 3D puzzle of the entire HUNTR/X crew, with chibi or manga-style depictions of Rumi, Zoey and Mira.

This kit contains 212 foam puzzle pieces and the finished display piece measures 15.7 x 11.4 inches in size.

DOUBLES AS DESK DECOR

KPop Demon Hunters Sneaker 3D Jigsaw Puzzle

$19.99

And you can pick up this 3D sneaker puzzle, with 108 plastic pieces that snap together.

The sneaker features an image of HUNTR/X promoting their “Takedown Tour,” and the finished product can be displayed on its own or used as a pencil cup or small vase. The 3D sneaker measures approximately 8.4 x 5.3 inches in dimension.
